details: The US annual inflation rate climbed to 3.7% in September 2026, surpassing market expectations of 3.6% and increasing from 3.4% in August. This rise, largely driven by higher energy prices (gasoline up 34.2% year-over-year), has led to concerns about the Federal Reserve's interest rate policy and caused a downturn in global financial and cryptocurrency markets. Wholesale inflation also surged to its highest level in over four years, further indicating broadening price pressures. This hotter-than-expected inflation data suggests a higher likelihood of the Fed maintaining a "higher-for-longer" interest rate path.
title: US Inflation Exceeds Forecasts, Sparking Market Concerns

details: The International Monetary Fund (IMF), in its October 2026 World Economic Outlook, projects a slowdown in global economic growth to 3.1% in 2026, down from 3.5% in 2025. The IMF attributes this outlook to ongoing geopolitical conflicts, volatility in energy prices, and increasing public debt. While AI investment is seen as a supportive factor, the report cautions that buffers against economic shocks are diminishing. A more severe scenario, where oil prices remain above $130 per barrel into early 2027, could further reduce global growth and push inflation higher.
title: IMF Warns of Global Economic Slowdown Amid Geopolitical Tensions

details: The US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) issued a temporary "Innovation Exemption" on September 17, 2026, designed to facilitate the on-chain secondary trading of tokenized versions of US exchange-listed stocks. This five-year conditional exemption allows new "Tokenized Securities Venues" (TSVs) to operate without registering as traditional exchanges and provides relief for certain liquidity providers. Public companies are notified before their stock is tokenized by a third party and have a 30-day window to object. This move is intended to foster innovation by integrating traditional financial assets with blockchain technology.
title: SEC Introduces "Innovation Exemption" for Tokenized Stock Trading

details: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced on October 9, 2026, that the United States intends to seize approximately $1 billion in cryptocurrency assets linked to Iran within the week. This action is part of an intensified "absolute isolation campaign" aimed at increasing economic pressure on Tehran, which also includes financial restrictions and efforts to disrupt Iran's access to international financial markets. The move follows previous US sanctions against Iranian crypto exchanges and wallet freezes throughout 2026.
title: US Plans Seizure of $1 Billion in Iran-Linked Crypto

details: Coinbase Global, Inc. has announced that it will release its third-quarter 2026 financial results and related materials on Thursday, October 29, 2026, after the market closes. The company will also host a live question and answer session on X (formerly Twitter) and YouTube on the same day.
title: Coinbase to Announce Q3 2026 Financial Results
